rule.statement: A change in character of the Defendants using a footpath from not being adverse to being adverse, with an intent to possess the land in detriment to the interest of the true owner’s rights, must be established in evidence to claim a right by prescription over the said land.
rule.supporting_quote: Even though the Civil Appeal High Court came to a finding that the Defendants used the disputed roadway since 1976, a change in character of the Defendants using a footpath from that of not being adverse to that of being adverse, with an intent to possess the land in detriment to the interest of the true owner’s rights, has not been established in evidence.
